title: init cannot choose the id prefix of a new queue
lead: A new queue always gets the default scheme (prefix `S`, width 2), and no command can change it: `slicer init --id sp-01` fails with "'sp-01' is not an id of this scheme; expected the form S01", `id-prefix` only changes case, and `add --id sp-01` on a default queue mints a mixed-scheme id that fails `check`. The only route is hand-editing `id.prefix` in `.slicer/config.json` right after `init` (which S10 made effective), against the `slicer ai` rule never to edit tracking files.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Per-product queues in one super-repo need distinct prefixes (`db-`, `st-`, `ob-`, `sp-`) so ids are unambiguous across queues and in commit messages. On 2026-10-09 the suite's new squalplot queue had to be seeded by hand: `slicer init`, then set `id.prefix` to `sp-` in `config.json` before filing anything. An agent following `slicer ai` cannot do that without an owner exception.

Suggested shape (to settle in the spec): an init option that takes the prefix and width (for example prefix sp- with width 2), and/or letting `init --id` set the scheme when the queue is empty. `id-prefix` could also accept a different prefix, not only a different case, while no item exists yet.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: src/slicer/cli.py, src/slicer/ops.py, tests/test_cli.py, README.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/commands.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Before implementation, the new custom-scheme, force-empty, force-preservation, and populated-queue refusal tests failed because init rejected the new flags. Existing initialization tests remain regression coverage. New checks also assert persisted scheme values, empty and populated render/check success, and byte-for-byte preservation of files on validation failures.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add init --id-prefix PREFIX and --id-width WIDTH; retain --id as the starting ID validated against the chosen scheme. Fresh queues default to S, width 2, counter 1. With --force, omitted scheme flags retain the existing scheme and the counter is preserved unless --id is supplied. Allow scheme changes only when no items exist; reject scheme or starting-counter changes with items before any write. Keep id-prefix case-only. Move initialization validation and persistence into ops.py; keep parsing, output and Git hints in cli.py. Update help, README and configuration documentation. No dependencies or JSON response changes.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Initialize an empty directory with prefix sp- and width 2: config id is {"prefix":"sp-","width":2}, next-id is sp-01, and render then check passes before and after adding items. Cover defaults, custom width and matching starting ID, sequential allocation, invalid scheme/starting ID without writes, force on empty queues retaining omitted scheme parts and counters, matching scheme on populated queues, and populated queues rejecting scheme/counter changes without writes. Run init-focused tests, affected tests (full discover if the map is missing), the full unittest suite, slicer check, and git diff --check.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree .worktrees/s242; branch feature/s242-init-id-scheme. After passing checks, record a review note and handoff with render/check, then commit implementation, documentation, tests and tracking state together as: s242: Allow choosing the ID scheme during init. Owner authorized the commit; no merge or push.
